arch:
Services

Tax Resolution

Resolve your tax issues with confidence through our expert tax resolution services. From managing IRS notices to negotiating payment plans, we help you navigate challenges and regain control.

Tax Planning

Plan ahead and save more with our proactive tax planning solutions. We help you navigate complex regulations, minimize liabilities, and maximize savings, ensuring your business remains compliant and profitable year-round. 

Bookkeeping

Stay organized and in control with our precise bookkeeping services. We handle your financial records with accuracy, ensuring up-to-date data that helps you make informed business decisions while saving you time and stress. 

Companies Registration

We assist with all aspects of company incorporation, including filing necessary documents, registering your business name, and obtaining required licenses. Our services ensure your business is legally compliant and ready to operate smoothly from day one.

Fractional CFO

Gain access to expert financial leadership with our Fractional CFO services. From cash flow management to strategic planning, we provide the insights and strategies needed to drive your business toward long-term success.

Tax Preparation

Streamline your tax season with our reliable and efficient tax preparation services. We ensure timely filings, minimize errors, and keep you stress-free with accurate documentation tailored to your specific needs. 

Our Process in Four Easy Steps

1

Schedule a Consultation 

Book a time to meet with our experts to discuss your financial needs and goals.

2

Comprehensive Analysis

We dive deep into your financial data to identify key opportunities and challenges.

3

Review and Customize Your Plan

Receive a detailed proposal with tailored services and solutions.

4

Sign The Contract and Let's Begin

Finalize the agreement, and we’ll handle the rest while you focus on growth.

Get Back Time, Save on Taxes, and Unlock Financial Planning 

Schedule a call and discover how we can help you

Schedule A Free Consultation

"I spent a long time searching for a company that could handle the bookkeeping and accounting for our e-com business, which operates across multiple sales channels and has numerous integrations. This company exceeded my expectations. They are highly professional, thorough, and have a deep understanding of complex business needs. Their expertise has brought a lot of clarity and organization to our financial processes, and I would highly recommend them to any business looking for reliable and skilled accounting services."

Michael Zavyalov
CEO

"I’ve been working with Julia and Maria for a while now. They go above and beyond with their work and put genuine efforts while doing things. Every single meeting they propose new procedures and processes that would save time and make everyone’s work more efficient. That is exactly what makes them different from any other adviser that I’ve worked with."

Marko Zivanovic
Owner at Prime Road Carriers INC

"In all honesty, our company is thrilled to have found Julia and her staff. At first we were hesitant because of the price. But now, we feel so lucky and blessed. Thay came in and implemented necessary procedures and cleaned us up. Finally an accounting firm who cares. They gave us a lot, I mean a lot, of work to do, just like a good hard coach of a basketball or football team would do. All the other companies we had used did the least amount of work and gave no advice. We/I highly recommend them if you have a serious business. They become part of the team!

Edward Kissel
Owner of Mobilesource Corp

Our Valued Partners

We are in good company.
